simple.summary: מַעֲקָשׁ (maʻăqâsh) means a crook (in a road) First listed occurrence: Isa 42 16.

definitions.full: H4625. maaqash [ מַעֲקָשׁ ] noun [masculine] twisted, crooked place ; — plural מַעֲקַשִׁים Isa 42:16 (opposed to מִישׁוֺר ).
